---
applyTo: "src/main/resources/db/**/*.sql"
---
# Flyway / MySQL DDL rules
- Source of truth: EDU-DDD-001 §5–§9 + docs/ai/03-data-model-mysql.md. Never invent tables/columns; keep constraint names (pk_, fk_<table>_<col>, uq_, ck_, ix_, trg_).
- New change = new file V{n}__snake_desc.sql. Never edit a migration already merged to main.
- Every table: ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci. Times: DATETIME(6) in UTC with DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6).
- Partial unique index → STORED generated column + UNIQUE. Partial index → composite index whose column order matches the real query (equality columns first, range/sort columns last); if an FK column leads it, it also serves as the FK index.
- Case-sensitive CHECKs: CAST(x AS BINARY) comparison or REGEXP_LIKE(x, pattern, 'c').
- Enum-like CHECKs (value lists) in every table: CAST(col AS BINARY) IN ('a','b') — utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci would accept 'A'.
- Constraint the DDD marks only as UQ → uq_<table>_<column> with the full column name (e.g. uq_user_tokens_token_hash). DDD-given names stay verbatim.
- Triggers: one per event (_bi/_bu/_bd), SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' with MESSAGE_TEXT starting with the BR code.
- No CHECK on a column whose FK uses CASCADE/SET NULL (MySQL error 3823).
- Seed data only under db/seed; deterministic explicit IDs; BCrypt hashes must be generated by running a tool, never typed.
